race.name: Hush Elves
race.physicalDescription: Pale forest dwellers who cultivate silence and communicate with hand signs while hunting.

traits: Treats coincidences as sacred messages and constantly rearranges plans to follow them.
Keeps trophies from failures rather than victories and can recount every lesson attached to them.

talents: Cold Immunity — The character cannot be frozen by ordinary cold.
equipment: Epic light armor — Remarkable weightless protection crafted through rare techniques.
Crossbow — A powerful mechanical ranged weapon with unlimited ordinary bolts.
inventory: Lantern and oil — A hooded lantern with enough oil for several hours.
Climbing kit — Pitons, a hammer, straps, and simple climbing aids.
Shovel — A compact but sturdy digging tool.
